xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4947: Agent MCP and bots (W-FUN1): Opt-in public /mcp through Tailscale Funnel

plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-FUN1): Opt-in public /mcp through Tailscale Funnel

metadata.sizeJustification: 27 files over 7 lint subsystems, but this is already one child of the decomposed PAN-4927 epic: switch, gate, middleware, route and panel are gated by one flag and verified together by one end-to-end acceptance (AC-18). 9 files are tests and 5 are docs; a further split would ship a switch with no surface or a public surface with no rate limit or audit.

plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Hosted bots (Grok Bot, the xAI API) cannot join the tailnet or run the Overdeck connector, so they need a public HTTPS URL for /mcp. Gate rule 0 (src/dashboard/server/remote-request-gate.ts:134-136) answers 404 to every Tailscale Funnel request except POST /hooks/*, so /mcp and the OAuth endpoints shipped by W-OAUTH1 are unreachable from the internet.
narratives.Proposal: Add an operator-only switch mcp.public.enabled (global config.yaml only, cached read, narrow write door, stripped from the project layer). While it is on, gate rule 0 admits exactly nine raw-path surfaces (POST /mcp, three /.well-known metadata GETs, five /oauth/mcp endpoints); /mcp over Funnel accepts only OAuth tokens (403 otherwise); one global middleware rate-limits Funnel requests (60/min per OAuth token on /mcp, 60/min per IP for the authorize status poll, 20/min per IP otherwise; 429 + Retry-After) and writes one activity entry per request without any token. A root-only GET/PUT /api/mcp/public and a Settings > Anywhere panel turn it on and print the three Funnel commands. Overdeck never runs tailscale. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-4947.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Overdeck running `tailscale` or checking Funnel mounts (CP-10 is an operator step after merge)
- A `pan mcp public` CLI verb
- Revoking or expiring OAuth sign-ins when the switch turns off
- Any behavior change to the OAuth server (W-OAUTH1), the approval card or sign-in list (W-OAUTH2), or bot integrations
- Public reach for any /api/*, /events/*, /ws/*, SPA path, GET /mcp or DELETE /mcp
- Rate limiting or auditing non-Funnel requests
- Persisting rate-limit counters across restarts
- Changing src/lib/settings-api.ts or the whole-document Settings save
- Reading the switch from a project .pan.yaml

autoDecisions.summary: Read mcp.public.enabled from the global config.yaml only, cached with invalidatePublicMcpConfig(), instead of the epic's loadConfigSync().
autoDecisions.rationale: loadConfigSync merges the project layer (a committed .pan.yaml could open Funnel), stats files on every gate call, and is bound to a module-constant path that tests cannot redirect; remote-access/config.ts already uses the cached global-read pattern for the gate.

autoDecisions.summary: Write the switch through a narrow YAML write door (public-mcp-write.ts) and drop the epic's settings-api.ts change and public-mcp.json fallback (CP-4 resolved at plan time).
autoDecisions.rationale: saveSettingsApi never writes or deletes the mcp block (verified in writeYamlConfigPreservingComments), so the epic's approach would silently save nothing; selection-write.ts is the established narrow-door precedent.

autoDecisions.summary: Give GET /oauth/mcp/authorize/status its own 60/min per-IP bucket instead of sharing the 20/min OAuth bucket.
autoDecisions.rationale: The authorize page polls every 2 s (30/min) for up to 10 minutes, so a shared 20/min bucket would throttle every browser sign-in.

autoDecisions.summary: Rate limiting and audit live in one global middleware (public-mcp-funnel.ts) rather than in routes/mcp.ts and eight OAuth handlers.
autoDecisions.rationale: One place covers all nine surfaces without touching mcp-oauth.ts handlers; the middleware re-checks the gate's admit condition so middleware order does not matter (linked-conversation-proxy precedent).

autoDecisions.summary: Audit entries are written only while the switch is on.
autoDecisions.rationale: AC-18's 'each request writes one entry' sits in the switch-on clause; while off, surface requests are ordinary Funnel 404s and a public scanner must not fill the activity feed.

autoDecisions.summary: Match surfaces on the exact raw path (no decoding or normalization).
autoDecisions.rationale: The router matches the raw path; a path that only normalizes to a surface (/api/../mcp, //mcp, /mcp/) must not pass the gate.

autoDecisions.summary: Name the API field mcpUrl instead of the epic's baseUrl, and add no CLI verb.
autoDecisions.rationale: The value is the /mcp URL; the epic names no CLI verb for this switch, and the Settings panel plus PUT /api/mcp/public are sufficient doors.

items.title: Add the public MCP switch module: surfaces, cached global-only read, write door, project-layer strip

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4947.md WI-1 exactly. Create src/lib/mcp/public-mcp.ts (read side: PUBLIC_MCP_FUNNEL_PORT, PUBLIC_MCP_MOUNTS, PUBLIC_MCP_SURFACES with the nine 'METHOD path' strings, publicMcpSurface(method, url) matching the raw path before ?/# exactly with no decoding or normalization, isPublicMcpEnabled() reading join(getOverdeckHome(),'config.yaml') with readFileSync + js-yaml folded through mergeMcpConfig(defaultMcpConfig(), parsed), cached, false on any error, invalidatePublicMcpConfig(), publicMcpFunnelCommands(port = triggerDashboardPort()) and publicMcpFunnelOffCommands() producing the D-10 strings). This module must NOT import settings-api.ts. Create src/lib/mcp/public-mcp-write.ts with savePublicMcpEnabled(enabled) modelled on src/lib/color-themes/selection-write.ts: runSettingsWriteSerialized, parseDocument, ensure mcp and mcp.public are maps, doc.setIn(['mcp','public','enabled'], enabled), writeFileAtomic(path, text, 0o600), clearConfigCache(), invalidatePublicMcpConfig(). Given a cached value, when config.yaml is rewritten without calling invalidatePublicMcpConfig(), then isPublicMcpEnabled() returns the old value, and after invalidatePublicMcpConfig() it returns the new value

items.title: Given a Funnel POST /mcp with a pan-token-create style token (no oauthClientId), then the route returns 403 with body { "error": "public MCP accepts only OAuth sign-ins" }

Add the fixed-window rate limiter with an injected clock and key cap

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-4. Create src/dashboard/server/public-mcp-rate-limit.ts exporting PUBLIC_MCP_WINDOW_MS = 60_000, PUBLIC_MCP_MAX_KEYS = 10_000, RateDecision, FixedWindowLimiter { hit(key, limit); size() } and createFixedWindowLimiter({ now?, windowMs?, maxKeys? }). The window starts at a key's first request; a refused hit does not increment; retryAfterSeconds = max(1, ceil((windowStart + windowMs - now)/1000)); inserting a new key while size >= maxKeys evicts the first (oldest-inserted) Map key. Test with an injected now(); never real sleeps.

items.title: Given limit 60 and one key, when hit is called 61 times at the same instant, then the first 60 return allowed and the 61st returns allowed:false with retryAfterSeconds 60, and 45 s later a refused hit returns retryAfterSeconds 15
Given a refused key, when the injected clock advances 60 s, then the next hit is allowed and starts a fresh count
Given two keys, then hits on one never change the other's decision, and limit 20 refuses the 21st hit
Given maxKeys 3, when a fourth key is hit, then size() stays 3 and the oldest-inserted key starts a fresh window on its next hit
Add the Funnel middleware that rate-limits and audits every public MCP request

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-5 and decisions D-5..D-8. Create src/dashboard/server/public-mcp-funnel.ts exporting makePublicMcpFunnelLayer({ limiter, audit }) and publicMcpFunnelLayer (createFixedWindowLimiter() + emitActivityEntry), a global HttpRouter.middleware. It passes through untouched unless the request is a Funnel request, isPublicMcpEnabled() is true and publicMcpSurface(method, url) is not null. Keys: token:<tokenId>/60 for POST /mcp whose resolveDashboardCredential is a token with oauthClientId; poll:<ip>/60 for GET /oauth/mcp/authorize/status; ip:<ip>/20 otherwise; ip = first x-forwarded-for entry trimmed, else 'unknown'. Over the limit: 429 { error: 'rate_limited' } with Retry-After and Cache-Control no-store, audited at level warn. Otherwise run httpEffect and audit its status once (a failing inner effect audits 500 and the failure propagates unchanged). Audit = { source: 'dashboard', level, message: 'Public MCP <METHOD> <rawPath-without-query> <status>', details: JSON.stringify({ clientId }) }, clientId from the OAuth credential, or the client_id query parameter on GET /oauth/mcp/authorize, else null. Never read a body. Merge publicMcpFunnelLayer into makeRoutesLayer in src/dashboard/server/server.ts right after remoteRequestGateLayer.

items.title: Given the switch on and one x-forwarded-for IP, when POST /oauth/mcp/register arrives through Funnel 21 times in one window, then the 21st returns 429 with a Retry-After header while a request from a different IP is still allowed

Given the switch on, when GET /oauth/mcp/authorize/status arrives 61 times from one IP, then the first 60 pass and the 61st returns 429; when POST /mcp arrives 61 times with one OAuth token, then the 61st returns 429 while a second OAuth token still passes

Given the switch on, when any of the nine surfaces is requested through Funnel, then the audit function is called exactly once with message 'Public MCP <METHOD> <path> <status>' and details containing clientId, and no audit message or details contains the bearer token, '?', 'code=' or 'code_verifier'
Given a non-Funnel request or the switch off, then the middleware calls the audit function zero times and never returns 429
Given an inner route that fails, when a Funnel surface request runs, then the audit function records status 500 once and the failure still reaches the caller
